record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare DRAGON_TAIL: Trapinch (1 star), Vibrava (2 stars), Flygon (3 stars). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (table index), range and maxPP. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Deals SPECIAL damage (raw 30/60/100/150 by the caster's stars) to the cast target, then gives the caster +DEF and +SPE_DEF of the same requested size (2/4/6/10). The buff is applied to the caster itself and is not conditioned on the damage result.

targeting.who: damage: the cast target; buffs: the caster itself
targeting.note: The caster must reach its target (requiresTarget true). No area or secondary target. Which unit is chosen as cast target is decided by generic targeting code, which was not read.

effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1]. handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) because apBoost defaults to true; x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite on the target) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); also x2 once with the DOUBLE_DAMAGE effect and x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT as read in AQUA_TAIL's sibling record.
effects.resolution: applied (figure handed to PokemonState.handleDamage) = requested after those multipliers. handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1, and the target's shield absorbs first. takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp); 0 if the target has protect / skydiving / magicBounce.

effects.scaling: PokemonEntity.addDefense with apBoost 1: Math.round(value x (1 + AP/100) x (critPower if the cast crit)); then Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down if the caster holds it (positive value); Twist Band does nothing (acts only on negative values).
effects.resolution: applied = the rounded/belted value added to the caster's current def (floor 0). Not permanent (permanent defaults to false), so it changes the in-fight entity only. Stacks additively on repeated casts; no cap seen.

effects.scaling: PokemonEntity.addSpecialDefense with apBoost 1: same chain as DEF - Math.round(value x (1 + AP/100) x crit), Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down, Twist Band irrelevant.
effects.resolution: applied = the processed value added to the caster's speDef (floor 0), not permanent, additive on repeated casts. Because the damage is applied first, the speDef gain does not affect that cast's own damage to the target.

starBehavior.note: Both tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star column (150 / 10, also the ?? fallback) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts of these three units. Whether other mechanics raise a star count was not examined.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP (floor 0), deals its damage again and adds another DEF and SPE_DEF gain on top (additive, within the fight).
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 30/60/100 and DEF/SPE_DEF +2/+4/+6 for 1/2/3 stars. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then reduced by the target's SPE_DEF with a minimum of 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. Applied buff = requested after Math.round with AP and crit, then Big Eater Belt (x1.25 rounded down) if held; Twist Band cannot apply to a positive self buff. Final values additionally depend on untraced item and field effects.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which unit is the cast target and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located

Damage resolution after handleDamage's earlier branches (e.g. Shiny Charm, Fossil shield, resurrection, passives, weather and field multipliers) was only partly read: protect, SPE_DEF division, minimum 1 and shield absorption were read; later death handling was not
unresolved: Order is damage first, then DEF, then SPE_DEF: if the damage kills the target or triggers an on-death effect, effects keyed to that were not traced
The buffs are applied even if the damage was blocked (protect / magic bounce): they are not conditioned on the damage result
Helpers consulted: addDefense / addSpecialDefense, applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff and applyTwistBandBuff in pokemon-entity.ts were read (see evidence); no routing uncertainties are listed for this record
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
